title: Amazing experience
text: A phenomenal experience, but the best thing about this tour was definitely Gaspar, our guide, who made this experience unforgettable.
author: 987hectorp

title: Wonderful day
text: I was so impressed with our guide, Gaspar and our day.  The boat ride went to a beautiful cove.  The ruins were much larger than we thought and amazing and right by the sea.  The restaurant was chosen with care.  It was local and delicious.  We also stopped at a medieval town that was beautiful.  And at the same time all the power went out in Spain but Gaspar managed to still give us an excellent day.
author: sandrahK8338EF

title: Great tour guide.
text: Gaspar was a wonderful tour guide. Picked us up promptly, took us to the boat ride first since it looked like it might rain later. Made reservations at a local restaurant, at our request, which was delicious. Gave us a lot of history during the drive, of the regions we were traveling through and Empuries. Best day we had on this vacation to Barcelona!
author: GrandTour56086368114

title: Costa Brava & Empuries tour
text: Vincent was fantastic.  Very Knowledgeable, and extremely well spoken.  He was very engaging with my teenage daughter and my 9 year old son.  The ruins were fascinating, and Vincent took the time to chat one on one with each child and explain the history. Truly an exceptional experience for the family.  And also our driver Joaquin, who was great, got us to our destinations and back in a timely manner.  Big thank you to all!
author: Paul R

title: Educational and Interesting experience
text: Both the boat tour of the Medas Islands and the tour of the ruins of the city of Emporion were very interesting
author: isabelbY8220GM

title: Lovely.
text: Ampuriabrava has surprised us for good, it is beautiful to walk along its canals and the beach is very good is clean there is no crowding and you have to do all kinds of leisure, eat, shop, sports... , I will return.
author: Marietar777

title: Amazing tour
text: This trip was purely fantastic!!!! I truly enjoyed the being able to see most of Costa brava, from Roman and Greek ruins, to a nice beach bathing time, to lunch in a quaint town in San Marti de alpinista and then a boat tour with under water views in l’estratit it was a wonderful experience Vicente y Joaquin we’re awesome guide and driver
author: DianaR130

title: Awesome
text: I really enjoyed Empuries and the whole trip. Had an amazing experience with Luis and Ruben. Highly recommended.
author: Pabloso29

title: Great day trip with Reuben
text: We really enjoyed the day trip up the coast from Barcelona to Empuries to see the Greek and Roman ruins.  Very interesting and a beautiful location.  Lunch at Estartit, and a relaxing and fun boat ride to Medes Island.  The caves and shoreline are beautiful.  We loved it!
author: lbingham208

title: Interesting site
text: The museum is small, because of the works I think. But the visit to the Greek site and the Roman site are interesting and pleasant, under the sun of Empuries. the audio guide handed in at the entrance is interesting and allows to project into the sites in the time of their fullness, before they become ruins. The reconstructed mosaics are beautiful.
author: Michel G
